scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.test.yaml --profile test run --rm e2e
scripts.verify:e2e: pnpm stack:reset && pnpm stack:start && pnpm stack:smoke && E2E_REQUIRE_CLEAN_ARTIFACT=1 pnpm test:e2e && (cd api && TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://scheduler:scheduler@localhost:${POSTGRES_PORT:-55432}/scheduler go test -race ./... -count=1 && TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://scheduler:scheduler@localhost:${POSTGRES_PORT:-55432}/scheduler go test -race ./internal/postgres -run 'TestConcurrentConfirmationAllowsAtMostOneWinner|TestIdempotency' -count=20) && pnpm build:check
scripts.production:start: docker compose --project-name booking-scheduler-prod --env-file deploy/production.env -f compose.production.yaml up -d --wait
scripts.production:stop: docker compose --project-name booking-scheduler-prod --env-file deploy/production.env -f compose.production.yaml down
scripts.go:format:check: cd api && test -z "$(git ls-files '*.go' | xargs gofmt -l)"
scripts.stack:reset: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.test.yaml --profile test down --volumes --remove-orphans
